summary: Edits the parametric U/V basis of spline curves and surfaces, including knot parameterization, mapping, origin/length/scale changes, and order raising.

key_params.name: group
key_params.note: Spline primitive group; non-spline types are ignored

key_params.name: uparmtype
key_params.note: U parameterization mode such as unchanged, uniform, chord length, centripetal, or manual

key_params.name: uorigin
key_params.note: Set the U basis origin when origin editing is enabled

key_params.name: ulength
key_params.note: Set the U basis length when length editing is enabled

key_params.name: orderu
key_params.note: Raise the spline order in U

key_params.name: vbasis
key_params.note: Enable V basis editing for spline surfaces

common_gotchas: Ratio-preserving reparameterizations keep shape, while non-ratio-preserving changes can visibly reshape NURBS or Bezier primitives.
V operations only apply to spline surfaces and are ignored for curves.
Profiles on spline surfaces are affected when surface basis ratios change.
key_concepts: Basis SOP edits the parametric U and V domains of spline curves and surfaces.
Ratio-preserving parameterization changes keep NURBS shape, while non-ratio changes can reshape the primitive.
U controls affect curves and surfaces, while V controls apply only to spline surfaces.
Manual knot and order controls must respect spline knot-count and order constraints.
